judgement.reason: Snipe-IT is a Laravel web app on MySQL whose uploads can move to S3 with a contained change, so the outcome DEPLOYABLE_WITH_CHANGES stands.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /var/lib/snipeit (Dockerfile)
reviews.reason: The Dockerfile symlinks uploads, private uploads, backups and OAuth keys into /var/lib/snipeit, and no shown line in the production configuration selects S3 for that data: the S3 disk settings in .env.example are only commented-out options, so the local state finding is not disproven.
